newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's ANC to hold talks with leftist allies.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's ANC to hold talks with leftist allies.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela will lead an African National Congress delegation in talks on Thursday with the party's trade union and communist alliance partners, the ANC said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said Finance Minister Trevor Manuel, his deputy minister Gill Marcus, Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin and Labour Minister Tito Mboweni would be among those in the ANC team.
"The summit is a culmination of decisions of the ANC national executive committee 'lekgotla' (meeting) held earlier this year," the statement said.

The meeting, at a secret venue in Johannesburg, was aimed at strengthening the alliance with the Congress of South African Trade Unions and the South African Communist Party and improving communications between the three, it said.
The agenda included sharing "perspectives on the transformation", the statement said.
